title: can / can't – ability
grammarNote: CAN — это модальный глагол. Он выражает УМЕНИЕ или СПОСОБНОСТЬ делать что-то. Главное правило: после CAN глагол стоит в БАЗОВОЙ форме (инфинитив без 'to'). CAN не изменяется по лицам — для I, He, She, We, They он всегда одинаковый.

grammarTable.subject: I / You
grammarTable.example: I can swim fast. · You can speak English.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It
grammarTable.example: She can dance. · He can code in Python.

grammarTable.subject: We / They
grammarTable.example: We can help. · They can play volleyball.

grammarTable.subject: I / You
grammarTable.example: I can't drive. · You can't sing in tune.

grammarTable.subject: He / She / It
grammarTable.example: She can't cook. · He can't wake up early.

grammarTable.subject: We / They
grammarTable.example: We can't be late. · They can't speak French.

grammarTable.subject: Can + subject + verb?
grammarTable.example: Can you help me? · Can she dance? · Can they swim?

grammarTable.subject: Short answers
grammarTable.example: Yes, I can. / No, I can't. · Yes, she can. / No, he can't.

rows.example: I can play about twenty Kazakh songs.
She can speak French and English fluently.

rows.form: He can solve a Rubik's cube.
rows.example: He can solve it in under two minutes.
They can perform three different dances.
We can help each other with homework.

rows.form: It can connect to the internet.
rows.example: This laptop can connect anywhere.
I can't drive — I don't have a licence yet.
She can't even make a bowl of soup!
He can't sing — please don't ask him!

rows.form: We can't be late for class.
rows.example: We can't be late — the teacher marks attendance.
They can't speak Russian, only Kazakh.
I cannot attend today. (formal writing)
Can you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
Can she dance? — Yes, she can beautifully!
Can he code? — Yes, he can. He's the best.
What can you do? — I can play guitar.
How well can she sing? — Very well!
Where can we study? — In the library.
✅ She can dance. — CAN не меняется! Никакого -s!
✅ I can swim. — После CAN нет "to"!
✅ Can she dance? — Базовая форма в вопросе!
✅ He can't drive. — После CAN'T тоже нет 'to'!

grammarTip:
Три золотых правила CAN:
① CAN не меняется: I can · She can · They can (НЕ 'she cans'!)
② После CAN всегда базовый глагол: can swim · can dance (НЕ 'can to swim', НЕ 'can swimming'!)
③ Отрицание: can't = cannot. Краткое can't — в разговоре. Cannot — в формальном письме.

💡 Запомни пары: 'can' [kæn] (слабый звук в предложении) vs 'can't' [kɑːnt] (всегда ударный, чёткий!).

exercises.text: Zhibek ___ perform three traditional Kazakh dances.
exercises.hint: Zhibek = She → She can (NOT "cans"! CAN never takes -s).

exercises.text: Rustam ___ juggle three footballs at the same time.
I ___ cook well — my soup always tastes terrible!
exercises.hint: Negative of can = can't / cannot. Never 'cants' or 'cannot to'.

exercises.text: "Can she dances well?" is correct English.
exercises.hint: After Can → base form! "Can she dance well?" (no -s).
Short answer: Yes, he can. (never "cans", never "is can").

exercises.text: ___ you help me with the computer?

opts: She can to speak three languages.
I can't to wake up early.
exercises.hint: "They can swim and dive." ✅ — can + base verb. Others wrongly add "to" or "-s".
He can't + base verb = He can't sing.

questions.text: I ___ drive yet — I'm still learning.

questions.hint: After Can → base form: Can she dance?
Question: Can you...? → Yes, I can.

questions.text: How do you say "Она не умеет петь"?

questions.hint: cannot + base verb: I cannot swim. (no 'to'!)

questions.text: Kamila ___ sing, but she ___ play the dombra well.
What can / can't is can + not?
"___ Amir solve a Rubik's cube?" — "Yes, he ___."
questions.hint: Ability questions use Can. Short answer: Yes, he can.
CAN never takes -s. → She can speak English.

questions.text: I practise every morning but I ___ do a backflip.
Choose the correct translation: "Что ты умеешь делать?"
Which is the formal version of "can't"?
questions.hint: "cannot" (one word) is most common; "can not" is also acceptable in formal writing.
